talk.transcript: Today, we will discuss the importance of biodiversity. Biodiversity refers to the variety of life on Earth, including the variety of species, ecosystems, and genetic differences within species. It plays a critical role in sustaining ecosystem services, such as pollination, nutrient cycling, and climate regulation. A rich biodiversity can enhance resilience against environmental changes, while a loss in biodiversity can lead to ecosystem collapse. Preserving biodiversity is essential not only for the health of our planet but also for our well-being, as it directly impacts food security, clean water access, and medicinal resources.

questions.explain: 生物多樣性是指地球上生命的多樣性。

questions.explain: 生物多樣性可以提高對環境變化的抵抗力。

questions.q: How does biodiversity affect food security?
questions.explain: 生物多樣性對糧食安全有正面影響。
保護生物多樣性對生態系統的健康至關重要。
